messages:
sophia: Heads-up — ran a quick synthetic sweep for Orion-11B int8 vs fp16 on the QA microbench (newsqa+wiki). Results look weird: latency wins are good but recall drops on short contexts (~256 tokens). Full numbers attached below.
arjun: Can you paste the eval command + seed? did you use our standard prompt templates?
sophia: Eval command: ```./eval_runner --model=orion-11b --quant=int8 --batch=8 --context=256 --seed=42 --dataset=newsqa``` used standard prompt set v2.
mina: what's the magnitude of recall drop?
sophia: avg EM down 6.2 points vs fp16, F1 down 4.9. latency p99 ↓ 38%.
oliver: hmm big. any pattern by question length or position?
sophia: looks concentrated on short answers (1-3 tokens) and when model uses copying. attention heads seem noisier. log sample: ```pred: "the", gold: "an"```
eval-bot: Regression alert created: RG-2076543210 — Orion-11B/int8 QA recall delta > 5pt.
matt: Could be quantization bias on logits scale. Did you try per-channel vs per-tensor quant?
sophia: tried per-channel symmetric and asymmetric. per-channel reduced delta to 3.1 EM, still not trivial.
arjun: For product guidance, can we route short-context requests to fp16 variant and int8 for long? cost model?
mina: quick back-of-envelope: int8 cost per token ~ 0.45x of fp16 on our bench GPUs. So routing short ones to fp16 ups cost by ~12% overall for typical mix.
oliver: we should run small A/B on prod with canary traffic split on length. also check prompt-template sensitivity — sometimes adding answer-conditioning helps.
sophia: agreed. Plan: 1) run length-split A/B (256 cutoff) 2) try calibration trick (logit scaling) 3) collect eval set of short-copy cases 4) propose routing policy to product.
matt: For calibration: try temperature rescale on logits post-quant: q_logits *= 1.02. small but might help.
sophia: noted. I'll kick off two jobs and post results here. anyone want observer access to the runs?
arjun: me + mina, please.
sophia: added you. kicking now — ETA ~45m. ping when done :hourglass_flowing_sand:
